title: search query: unescaped special chars in subject/from filters
description: Lines 1126-1127 in crates/reader/src/session/lifecycle.rs build Tantivy query strings like 'subject:"%s"' but only escape double-quotes. Unescaped parentheses, backslashes, and other Tantivy syntax chars in the user's search value can cause parse errors or unexpected query behavior. Should either escape all special chars or use a safer query construction API.
